profile.headline: Motorsports IT Professional at Toyota Racing Development USA
profile.summary:
Lead platform engineer.

Currently building software used in the motorsports and automotive industries globally. Also have experience in building software for healthcare, insurance, call centers, and LED video products.

Expertise with Javascript/Typescript, PHP, Go, C++, and Java. Experience with Python, Dart, and Kotlin as well.

Experienced with Kubernetes, Serverless, distributed systems, cloud-native (emphasis on AWS) systems, Laravel, Cobra and Viper, Kubebuilder, NestJS, Java (Spring, Spring Boot), DevOps, and as a Developer Advocate/Developer Relations professional.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Internal Call Center CMS implemented with AngularDart and Java (Spring Boot). DynamoDB and Postgres. Also gained experience with ECS, Cucumber.js and Gherkin syntax, Jenkins for CI/CD.
Security dashboard for small businesses. Fullstack JS, react, serverless, dynamo, redis, SQS, Kinesis, StepFunctions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer for the Financial feature in their Hospital Management Suite. Backbone/Marionette, Java (Spring Framework), DB2. Assisted in transitioning UI development to Angular.
